brief:
The mayor of Dimona, a city near Israel's nuclear reactor, predicted a military escalation with Iran at dawn on Friday, Maan Wire reported. The official, described as close to Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu, offered no details about the nature or source of his forecast.

Dimona sits in Israel's south and has long been associated with the country's nuclear program. The prediction came without explanation of how the mayor obtained the information or what specific escalation he anticipated.
title: Dimona mayor close to Netanyahu predicts Iranian military escalation Friday dawn
